name: Asaph
bio: Asaph son of Berechiah was a Levite of the Gershomite clan. When David organized the Levites to carry the ark into Jerusalem with music and singing, Asaph was chosen as one of three chief singers, alongside Heman and Ethan, sounding bronze cymbals as the procession moved toward the city (1 Chronicles 15:16-19). He went on to lead Israel's worship for the rest of David's reign and is credited as the author or namesake of a whole collection of psalms (Psalms 50, 73-83).
